open_points.text: - handle_list_records: [FIELD_PROJECTION] MUST show each listed record that another handler answers alone as that handler shows it: a TrialCase as handle_add_trial_case, a TrialExecution as handle_try_implementation, a NodeExecution as handle_get_repair_view, a FlowVersion as handle_compose_flow_version, an Implementation as handle_get_implementation and a Run as handle_start_run; every other field of the RecordSet is copied into ShownRecords unchanged.

open_points.question: Must “every other field” be limited to fields that exist in ShownRecords, or must ShownRecords gain the RecordSet fields activations, flow_activations, spooled_files and stored_values?
